name: Pochampally Weaves
summary: Discover Pochampally’s ikat traditions through local weavers, vibrant yarns and traditional looms.
about: Travel from Hyderabad to the renowned weaving settlement of Pochampally, where textile traditions remain closely connected to village life and family-run workshops.

Meet members of the weaving community and follow the intricate journey of ikat from design preparation and yarn tying to dyeing, alignment and weaving. Unlike printed textiles, an ikat pattern is created by resist-dyeing selected sections of yarn before the threads reach the loom. The dyed warp and weft must then be aligned with remarkable precision to reveal the intended design.

Observe traditional looms in operation, learn how skills are passed between generations and explore the distinctive geometric language of Pochampally textiles. The full-day format allows additional time for deeper interaction, more stages of the weaving process and a relaxed local lunch.

name: Kanha Retreat
summary: Unwind at Kanha Shanti Vanam with Heartfulness, nature and quiet reflection.
about: Travel from Hyderabad to Kanha Shanti Vanam for an unhurried experience centred on meditation, nature and mindful awareness.

Discover the campus’s meditation spaces and green surroundings while being introduced to the principles of Heartfulness. Subject to advance arrangement, join a guided relaxation or introductory meditation session with a Heartfulness trainer, allowing time to experience the practice and ask questions.

Continue with a gentle walk through visitor-accessible gardens and pathways, observing the natural surroundings and learning about Kanha’s environmental initiatives. Quiet pauses along the way offer opportunities for personal reflection.

The half-day format provides an introduction to the setting and practice. The full-day option allows a slower pace, additional time in nature and a vegetarian lunch, with the final programme tailored to confirmed campus access and session availability.

name: Hyderabad by Night
tagline: Hussain Sagar · Buddha Statue · City Lights · Contemporary Hyderabad
summary: Experience Hussain Sagar, the Buddha Statue and Hyderabad’s waterfront lights on a scenic evening outing.
about: Discover Hyderabad as daylight softens and the waterfront takes on its evening atmosphere. Begin around Hussain Sagar, where open lake views provide a scenic introduction to the city after dark.

Admire the Buddha Statue rising from the lake and explore its place in Hyderabad’s urban landscape. Subject to operating schedules and weather, an optional boat ride from Lumbini Park offers a closer perspective of the monument and the surrounding waterfront.

Continue along the Tank Bund and Necklace Road area, combining a scenic drive with selected walking and photography stops. Hear how Hyderabad’s public spaces, leisure culture and changing skyline reflect the life of a growing city.
Pause for refreshments and enjoy time beside the water as lights and reflections transform the scene, bringing the evening to a relaxed close.
